question: Who among the following was the first Vice President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan **__was the first Vice President of India.
 
• Part V of the Constitution of India includes the office of the Vice-President of India.
 
• **Zakir Hussain **served as the third president of India.
 
• **Gopal Swarup Pathak **was the fourth vice president of India.
 
• **Varahagiri Venkata Giri **was the fourth president of India. He was the only president to be elected as an independent candidate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

 
 

 **Article**
 **Information**
 
 

 Article 63
 There shall be a Vice-President of India.
 
 

 Article 64
 The Vice-President shall be ex-officio Chairman of the Council of States and shall not hold any other office of profit
 
 

 Article 65
 The Vice-President to act as President or to discharge his functions during casual vacancies in the office, or during the absence, of President.
 
 

 Article 66
 The Vice President shall be elected by the members of an electoral college consisting of the members of both Houses of Parliament.
 
 

 Article 67
 A Vice-President may, by writing under his hand addressed to the President, resign his office
